title: Lockheed VP Jim Ryder: the veil thinning as weakening magnetosphere
summary: unidentified crew member tells of Lockheed VP Jim Ryder: the veil thinning as weakening magnetosphere, about present day at Lockheed Martin; Earth's magnetosphere, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: this guy Jim Ryder, this VP of space systems there saying that the vent the fail sorry, the veil is thinning and that that is literally the magnetosphere of the earth which is weakening right now.

plain: A crew member on a podcast says that Jim Ryder, described as a vice president of space systems at the aerospace company Lockheed Martin, talked about "the veil thinning." According to this account, Ryder meant it literally: the veil is the magnetosphere, the magnetic shield around the Earth, which he said is weakening right now. If true, it would tie an old spiritual phrase to a real physical change around the planet.
